retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, two-tone stencil portrait framed by a circular splatter halo on a distressed paper background.
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A male profile in high-contrast black and cream stencil style, set against a vibrant orange and red circular splatter element. The entire composition is layered over a wrinkled, stained paper texture with ink drips and spray-paint effects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile centered within a circular graphic frame
High-contrast black shadows against cream-colored highlights
Vibrant warm-toned splatter contrasting with neutral paper background
Typography angled upward following the curve of a bottom-right ink blot
coreInvariants: High-contrast threshold effect on the subject
Visible halftone dot patterns in mid-tones
Circular splatter halo framing the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular red/orange splatter halo behind the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the profile's gaze to the left, then drop down to the heavy black ink blot and angled text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The corners of the square frame consist of neutral, textured paper space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation warm halo and low-value black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky stems with slight western-style notches
Secondary text is thin, irregular, and mimics hand-painted lettering
Both lines are rotated approximately 15 degrees upward
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' and 'R' in the primary text feature sharp, angular spurs
The 'C' in the secondary text is oversized and expressive

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the bottom of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, aggressive block font paired with a chaotic, thin hand-drawn script for a 'street art' aesthetic.

preserve: Mix of blocky and script styles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the notched, heavy western-influenced display style
Matches the secondary text's raw, unpolished feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast stencil portrait of a man in profile, using black and cream tones with halftone dots. Place a circular red and orange spray-paint splatter halo behind the head. Set the entire image on a wrinkled, stained paper texture with black ink drips at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary display text in a heavy, white, notched slab-serif font at a 15-degree upward angle over the bottom-right ink drips. Add secondary text in a thin, white, hand-drawn script directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait high-contrast stencil style?
Is there a circular splatter halo?
Is the paper texture visible throughout?
Is the text angled and placed over an ink blot?

mustAchieve: High-contrast thresholding without losing facial structure

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone patterns in the mid-tones
Ensure the ink drips look organic and vertical
Verify the text is legible against the dark blot
Confirm the circular halo is centered behind the head
Check that the paper texture feels integrated, not just an overlay
recipe.reuseFormula: Stencil Portrait + Splatter Halo + Distressed Paper + Angled Block Typography
